description: Lists the Search Console and Google Analytics properties the connected Google accounts can read, the Bing Webmaster site for each, and which research keys are set. Call it first. With add: starts the weekly site audit of that site on the hosted server (a weekly crawl, daily Google index checks, a Monday email and webhook with what changed, and alerts when a page drops out of Google's index). A site that needs paying for returns a Stripe Checkout link: give it to the person to open, and the audit starts once they pay.

add.description: Optional. A site to add to the weekly site audit. Only when the person asks for it: a site can cost money.

name: seo_sites
title: List sites
